finding.detail: The bubble could be dragged by the person, but Aura had no governed action that could move it. The native panel retained a 520-point transparent hit-test surface while dormant, companion chat did not use the durable desktop delivery contract, and a queued move had no measured AppKit acknowledgement.

negative_controls: browser preview cannot consume native host commands
hidden or absent native bubble refuses movement
a later movement acknowledgement cannot close an earlier receipt
native panel never exceeds the bounded visible-content envelope

remaining_companion_work: enforce incognito and private-window refusal at every lowest-level screen capture boundary
enforce the runtime screen permission at every continuous and on-demand capture boundary
unify browser camera state with the canonical runtime camera authority and verify hardware state before reporting success
replace the permanently-disabled body camera sensor with truthful live state and provenance
make camera capture self-contained when only the native companion surface is open
treat vision worker initialization errors as failed readiness and prove crash recovery
prove general camera detail perception across lighting, occlusion, motion, distance, multiple people, and calibrated abstention
move synchronous camera operations off the event loop and preserve source, time, monitor, and privacy provenance
make governed autonomous camera observation available under durable opt-in
add visual and semantic page-revision detection plus bounded autonomous public research
prove live native movement, chat recovery, highlighting, voice, camera, hide, and restart continuity after app rebuild
